outcome: Density of Interstitial Cells of Cajal (ICC) in the urinary bladder
cohort: The study included fetal Wistar albino rats exposed to retinoic acid to induce myelomeningocele, sham-treated fetal rats, and control fetal rats.
finding: The density of Interstitial Cells of Cajal (ICC) in the urinary bladder was significantly decreased in the myelomeningocele (MMC) group compared to control and sham groups.
cross-section timing: Fetal rats harvested on 22nd embryologic day (equivalent to late gestation for rats).
gest_age: Fetuses harvested on 22nd embryologic day (rat gestational age).
